chunks: And from him, from Muhammad ibn Isa, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Abu Basir, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him)

key_terms.أَبُو بَصِيرٍ: Abu Basir (a companion of the Imams)
key_terms.أَبُو عَبْدِ اللَّهِ: Abu Abdillah (Imam al-Sadiq, peace be upon him)
key_terms.مِثْلُهُ: Like it / The same (referring to a previous ruling or narration)

ai.seo_question: What does the phrase 'mithlahu' indicate in Shia hadith literature regarding legal rulings?
ai.summary: This narration from Shaykh al-Tusi’s *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* serves as a cross-referential link (takhrij) within the chapter on *Dhahr*, confirming that the specific legal rulings previously detailed apply identically to this context. It underscores the consistency of the Imams' jurisprudence regarding the ritual divorce mechanism where a husband declares his wife like his mother's back, a practice requiring expiation (*kaffarah*) as established in Shia fiqh.
